verdict.rationale: Self-hosted sync is a fair question for an authenticator app that syncs or backs up secrets, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents Cloud Backup to a Microsoft personal account or iCloud. Nothing shows a self-hostable sync server or a way to keep secrets inside an organization's own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
